the functional genomic screen identified 4 genes that were associated with proliferation and that we found that chemical inhibitors of 3 of these 4 genes inhibited growth of sarcomas in vitro.

we have identified a number of novel targets for RMS treatment and that disruption of the cytoskeleton by latrunculins can reduce RMS proliferation.
